headlines.title: PBOC pledges support for stocks as China’s market slide defies rescue efforts
headlines.summary:
China’s central bank governor has reaffirmed support for the country’s beleaguered stock market after a series of rescue measures failed to put a floor under plummeting share prices.
Pan Gongsheng, governor of the People’s Bank of China (PBOC), pledged in a work report presented to the standing committee of the National People’s Congress on Tuesday that more actions would be taken to ease financial risks in key areas, including the capital market and the property sector.

headlines.title: 中国人民银行副行长邹澜出席第五届国际金融领袖投资峰会
headlines.summary: 2026年11月3日，第五届国际金融领袖投资峰会在香港举行，中国人民银行副行长邹澜出席会议并发言。 邹澜表示，中国经济发展呈现向新向优态势，持续依托扩大内需激活增长动力。中国人民银行将顺应中国金融结构的变迁趋势，推动货币政策框架逐步转型优化，为经济高质量发展营造良好的金融环境；将继续深化金融业高水平对外开放，支持香港国际金融中心建设，巩固香港离岸人民币业务枢纽地位。（中国央行网站）

headlines.title_en: PBOC Deputy Governor Zou Lan attends the 5th International Financial Leaders Investment Summit
headlines.summary_en: On November 3, 2026, the 5th International Financial Leaders Investment Summit was held in Hong Kong. PBOC Deputy Governor Zou Lan attended and spoke. Zou said China's economy is showing a trend of renewal and improvement, and continues to rely on expanding domestic demand to activate growth momentum. The PBOC will adapt to changes in China's financial structure, promote the gradual transformation and optimization of the monetary policy framework, and create a favorable financial environment for high-quality economic development; it will continue to deepen high-level opening up of the financial sector, support the development of Hong Kong as an international financial center, and consolidate Hong Kong's position as an offshore RMB business hub. (PBOC website)

headlines.title: 商务部回应欧盟对低价值进口商品叠加征收有关税费
headlines.summary: 欧盟自11月1日起对低价值进口商品征收2欧元手续费，此前已于7月开始征收3欧元关税。商务部新闻发言人黄玲在5日举行的例行新闻发布会上对此表示，中方高度关注欧方有关新规。跨境电商作为国际贸易的新业态、新模式，为全球企业和消费者提供了多元化选择。希望欧方审慎评估相关政策影响，为中欧在电商等领域合作创造有利条件。（新华社）

headlines.title_en: MOFCOM responds to the EU's cumulative levying of relevant taxes and fees on low-value imported goods
headlines.summary_en: Since November 1, the EU has imposed a 2-euro fee on low-value imported goods, after having imposed a 3-euro tariff starting in July. Ministry of Commerce spokesperson Huang Ling said at a regular press conference on the 5th that China is highly concerned about the EU's new rules. As a new form and model of international trade, cross-border e-commerce provides diversified choices for global companies and consumers. China hopes the EU will carefully assess the impact of the relevant policies and create favorable conditions for China-EU cooperation in e-commerce and other areas. (Xinhua News Agency)

headlines.title: 凯撒旅业：控股股东环海湾文旅拟增持不低于5000万元
headlines.summary: 凯撒旅业公告，控股股东青岛环海湾文化旅游发展集团有限公司拟自公告披露之日起2个月内，通过集中竞价交易增持公司股份，增持金额不低于人民币5000万元、不超过人民币6000万元，不设价格区间。资金来源为专项贷款与自有资金，其中专项贷款资金占比不超过90%，自有资金占比不低于10%。环海湾文旅已取得浦发银行青岛分行贷款承诺函，银行同意提供不超过5000万元的股票增持专项贷款，贷款期限不超过3年，具体以最终签署的借款合同为准。增持计划可能因资本市场变化或资金未能及时筹措等原因无法实施或无法全部实施；增持主体承诺在增持期间及计划完成后6个月内不减持公司股份。

headlines.title_en: Caissa Tosun: Controlling shareholder Huanhaiwan Cultural Tourism plans to increase its stake by no less than RMB 50 million
headlines.summary_en: Caissa Tosun announced that its controlling shareholder, Qingdao Huanhaiwan Cultural Tourism Development Group Co., Ltd., plans to increase its stake in the company through centralized bidding within 2 months from the date of the announcement, with the increase amount no less than RMB 50 million and no more than RMB 60 million, with no price range set. The funds will come from a special loan and its own funds, with the special loan accounting for no more than 90% and its own funds no less than 10%. Huanhaiwan Cultural Tourism has obtained a loan commitment letter from Shanghai Pudong Development Bank Qingdao Branch, under which the bank agreed to provide a special loan of no more than RMB 50 million for the share increase, with a term of no more than 3 years, subject to the final signed loan contract. The increase plan may fail to be implemented or fully implemented due to changes in the capital market or failure to raise funds in a timely manner; the increasing entity undertakes not to reduce its holdings of the company's shares during the increase period and within 6 months after the plan is completed.

headlines.title: 商务部回应扩大自美采购农产品：持开放态度 对等降税落地是前提
headlines.summary: 商务部新闻发言人黄玲在5日举行的例行新闻发布会上回答有关进口美国农产品的提问时表示，中美农产品贸易是双边经贸合作的重要组成部分。扩大两国在农业领域合作，既可以丰富两国民众的餐桌，也能给两国企业和农民提供稳定的经济收入，为双方带来实实在在的好处。中方一直对扩大自美采购农产品持开放态度，但前提是双方达成的“300亿对300亿”对等降税安排落地。希望美方与中方共同努力，通过共同降低关税、减少非关税壁垒、扩大市场准入等方式，为两国农产品贸易创造更多有利条件。（新华社）

headlines.title_en: MOFCOM on expanding purchases of US agricultural products: China is open to it, but implementation of reciprocal tariff cuts is a prerequisite
headlines.summary_en: Ministry of Commerce spokesperson Huang Ling, answering a question at a regular press conference on the 5th about imports of US agricultural products, said that China-US agricultural trade is an important part of bilateral economic and trade cooperation. Expanding cooperation in agriculture between the two countries can both enrich the tables of the two peoples and provide stable economic income for enterprises and farmers in both countries, bringing tangible benefits to both sides. China has always been open to expanding purchases of US agricultural products, but the premise is the implementation of the reciprocal tariff reduction arrangement of "300 billion versus 300 billion" reached by both sides. China hopes the US will work with China to create more favorable conditions for agricultural trade between the two countries by jointly reducing tariffs, reducing non-tariff barriers, and expanding market access. (Xinhua News Agency)

headlines.title: 国家算力互联互通区域（湖北）节点即将启动
headlines.summary: 11月4日从工业和信息化部新闻宣传中心获悉，2026中国5G+工业互联网大会将于11月18日至20日在湖北省武汉市举办，会上多项成果将首次在武汉发布。大会将启动全国第二批“5G+工业互联网”融合应用城市试点，首发国家算力互联互通“1+M+N”行业节点，启动国家算力互联互通区域（湖北）节点。同时，大会将联动国家制造业大基金、长江产业基金、未来产业（6G）基金等开展产融现场对接，推动技术成果与资本要素深度融合。（证券时报）

headlines.title_en: National Computing Power Interconnection Regional (Hubei) node to launch soon
headlines.summary_en: On November 4, it was learned from the Publicity Center of the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology that the 2026 China 5G+Industrial Internet Conference will be held in Wuhan, Hubei Province, from November 18 to 20, and a number of achievements will be released for the first time in Wuhan at the conference. The conference will launch the second batch of national pilot cities for integrated application of "5G+Industrial Internet," debut the national computing power interconnection "1+M+N" industry nodes, and launch the national computing power interconnection regional (Hubei) node. At the same time, the conference will coordinate with the National Manufacturing Fund, the Yangtze River Industrial Fund, and the Future Industry (6G) Fund to conduct on-site industry-finance matchmaking and promote the deep integration of technological achievements and capital elements. (Securities Times)

headlines.title: 报道：韩国考虑买入长期美债
headlines.summary: 韩国经济日报援引知情人士报道，韩国考虑大规模购买美国长期国债，以此增加其外汇储备并加强与华盛顿的经济联系。韩国政府和央行最近向美国提出了这一想法，美国给予了积极回应。购买的具体规模尚未确定，但预计韩国将至少购买数百亿美元的美国国债，足以显著提升其外汇储备。

headlines.title_en: Report: South Korea considers buying long-term US Treasuries
headlines.summary_en: The Korea Economic Daily, citing informed sources, reported that South Korea is considering large-scale purchases of US long-term Treasury bonds to increase its foreign exchange reserves and strengthen economic ties with Washington. The South Korean government and central bank recently proposed this idea to the United States, and the US responded positively. The specific scale of purchases has not yet been determined, but South Korea is expected to buy at least tens of billions of dollars of US Treasury bonds, enough to significantly boost its foreign exchange reserves.

headlines.title_en: Zhao Leji, in a discussion with representatives attending the NPC Standing Committee session, stresses deep study and implementation of the spirit of the Fifth Plenary Session of the 20th CPC Central Committee and strengthening NPC deputies' ideological, political, and disciplinary conduct
headlines.summary_en: Zhao Leji, member of the Standing Committee of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and Chairman of the National People's Congress Standing Committee, held a discussion and exchange on the morning of the 5th with NPC deputies attending the 25th session of the 14th NPC Standing Committee. He stressed that NPC deputies should take the lead in studying, publicizing, and implementing the spirit of the Fifth Plenary Session of the 20th CPC Central Committee, implement it in light of their job responsibilities, strengthen their ideological, political, and disciplinary conduct, and improve their ability to perform duties in accordance with the law.

headlines.title_en: Saudi Arabia and Syria sign defense cooperation agreement
headlines.summary_en: According to Saudi sources on the 4th, Saudi Arabia and Syria signed a defense ministry cooperation agreement that day, with specific details not yet announced. The agreement was signed during a visit by Syrian transitional government President Ahmed al-Sharaa to the Saudi capital Riyadh. Al-Sharaa met with Saudi Crown Prince and Prime Minister Mohammed bin Salman that day, marking the second meeting between the two in Saudi Arabia in less than a month. Syria began carefully weighing the provision of military assistance to Saudi Arabia last month. Yemen's Houthi forces continue to launch missile and drone attacks on Saudi Arabia, and Saudi Arabia is seeking offensive and defensive support from the US, Europe, and multiple Middle East parties. According to several media outlets, the two sides also signed other agreements and memoranda of understanding involving infrastructure, energy, housing, health care, industry, agriculture, the environment, and financial services. headlines.title_en: Ministry of Finance settles and recovers the central government advance funds for the 2024 automobile trade-in subsidy program
headlines.summary_en: According to the Ministry of Finance's Notice on Issuing the Central Government Budget for Pre-allocated Subsidy Funds for Trade-ins of Old Automobiles in 2024 (Cai Jian [2024] No. 129), the Ministry of Finance and National Development and Reform Commission's Notice on the Settlement Results of 2024 Consumer Goods Trade-in Funds (Cai Jian [2026] No. 60), and your department's (bureau's) Application Form for Recovering 2024 Consumer Goods Trade-in Funds, part of the central government's 2024 pre-allocated fiscal interest subsidies and reward funds for automobile trade-ins in your province (region, corps) are hereby recovered (see attachment). Your province (region, corps) shall remit the funds to the central government treasury, include them under the 2026 government revenue and expenditure classification item "2300602 Special Remittance Expenditure," and process them through the 2026 year-end settlement between the central and local governments.

headlines.title: Chinese exporters see respite as Beijing curbs yuan rise amid looming record surplus
headlines.summary:

headlines.summary: 外交部发言人郭嘉昆主持例行记者会。法新社记者提问，据报道，中国已告知日本软银集团（SoftBank），不会批准其收购瑞士-瑞典合资企业ABB旗下的机器人业务。报道称，软银近期获悉该交易将被中国国家发展和改革委员会阻挠。外交部能否确认相关消息？ “这个问题建议向中方主管部门进行询问。”郭嘉昆说。（澎湃）

headlines.title_en: Will China's NDRC block SoftBank Group's acquisition of the robotics business of a Swiss-Swedish joint venture? Foreign Ministry responds
headlines.summary_en: Foreign Ministry spokesperson Guo Jiakun hosted a regular press conference. An AFP reporter asked that, according to reports, China has told Japan's SoftBank Group that it will not approve its acquisition of the robotics business under Switzerland-Sweden joint venture ABB. The report said SoftBank recently learned that the deal would be blocked by China's National Development and Reform Commission. Can the Foreign Ministry confirm the relevant information? "I suggest you ask the competent Chinese authorities about this question," Guo Jiakun said. (The Paper)

headlines.title_en: XingShuaiEr: Controlling shareholder, actual controller, and chairman propose share buyback of RMB 100 million to RMB 150 million
headlines.summary_en: Xingshuaier announced that on November 5, 2026, the company received a letter from controlling shareholder, actual controller, and chairman Lou Yongwei proposing a share repurchase. The proposal is to repurchase the company's A-shares through centralized bidding, with a total repurchase amount of no less than RMB 100 million (inclusive) and no more than RMB 150 million (inclusive), and the repurchase price not higher than 150% of the average trading price of the company's shares over the 30 trading days before the board resolution approving the repurchase, subject to the repurchase plan approved by the board; the funds will come from the company's own funds or self-raised funds, and the repurchase period will be within 3 months from the date the board approves the repurchase plan.
